packageRules.description: Coolify builds with Nixpacks 1.41.0, whose corepack 0.24.1 cannot start pnpm 11+ (it looks for bin/pnpm.cjs). Hold pnpm majors until the deploy path supports them; the nixpacks-install CI job checks it.

The nixpacks-install CI job pins the exact Node that Nixpacks 1.41.0 installs in production (NIXPACKS_NODE_VERSION=22 picks nodejs_22 from the frozen nixpkgs archive Nixpacks pins for the .nvmrc major: 22.19.0 with .nvmrc 24). Bump it only together with the production build or .nvmrc, never on its own.
